---
title: "Traits"
description: "The 3 traits of the abstraction catalog, one generated page each."
weight: 3
---

A trait adds behaviour to a component. Its optional posture decides what happens when nothing on the platform handles it. Generated from `example.com/catalogs/demo@v1` version `1.2.3`.

No transformer in this catalog handles these traits, so they are marked **Not implemented**: [Scaling](/catalogs/demo/1.2/traits/scaling/).

These traits are provider-fulfilled, so they are marked **Provided by your platform**: [Backup](/catalogs/demo/1.2/traits/backup-v1alpha1/). Your platform needs exactly one catalog that implements each.
